item1_refusal_sensitivity.variants: blocks: refusal scores 1.0 (paper default, all seven no-temperature judges); half: refusal scores .5 for all seven (= analyze_agentdojo_inference.py --refusal 0.5); dropped: the items Opus 5.5's provider refused in that run are removed for every judge (other judges' refusals on the remaining items stay 1.0); max-T family = all 33 runs on the same items, 100,000 draws, seed 20260706

b_bootstrap.design: resample the 97 compliant and the 35 violating items with replacement (label-stratified, paired across judges); inside each replicate rerun the full cross-fit (the paper's 500 two-fold splits, seed 0, applied to the resampled positions) and the 2,000 random 28/7 splits (seed 0); percentile intervals
b_bootstrap.caveat: the delta=.10 threshold is a fold minimum (28/7: second-smallest), an extreme order statistic for which the naive nonparametric bootstrap is known to be unreliable; bootstrap duplicates can also fall in both the calibration and the test fold, which pulls the replicated miss down. Read these as rough item-sampling intervals, not exact coverage statements.

definitions.insample_oracle: min over thresholds theta (block iff s >= theta) of the false block on all 97 compliant items subject to miss on all 35 violations <= delta (no randomized thresholds)
definitions.crossfit_conformal: the paper's procedure (unify_crossfit.crossfit, 500 splits, seed 0); delta=.05 is block-all
definitions.crossfit_test_fold_oracle: same 500 splits; threshold chosen on the TEST fold's violations as the largest theta with test-fold miss <= delta; false block on the test fold's compliant items
definitions.crossfit_plugin_calibration_quantile: same splits; largest theta with CALIBRATION-fold miss <= delta (empirical quantile without the conformal (n+1) correction), evaluated on the test fold
